g.text: The KiCad 3D preview in the lesson is a package illustration, not this wired circuit and not a tested PCB.

g.desc: The KiCad 3D preview in the lesson is a package illustration, not this wired circuit and not a tested PCB.

g.text: ERC and exact-net checks validate the schematic connections only; the breadboard circuit is not physically tested.

g.desc: ERC and exact-net checks validate the schematic connections only; the breadboard circuit is not physically tested.

g.text: Uno D2-D5 each drive one LED through a separate 1 kohm series resistor. LED anodes face the resistor/output; cathodes join ground.

g.desc: Uno D2-D5 each drive one LED through a separate 1 kohm series resistor. LED anodes face the resistor/output; cathodes join ground.

g.text: The drawing shows the external wiring only. Use LEDs with a suitable forward-current rating and check the MCU output limits.

g.desc: The drawing shows the external wiring only. Use LEDs with a suitable forward-current rating and check the MCU output limits.
